items.title: Consumers are already on their holiday shopping grind, set to outspend 2025
items.summary: Even though back-to-school shopping just wrapped, consumers may already be checking off holiday wishlists in September, according to a new Accenture survey. Accenture Global consumer goods, retail, and travel lead Kath Gramling comments on how early shoppers may already be on track to outspend 2025 as they attempt to "win the holiday" for their families.

items.title: What Is The Market Seeing In Accenture Stock That You Are Not?
items.summary: Accenture (ACN) produced free cash flow worth 11.7% of its market value over the last twelve months, against 4.4% for the median S&P 500 company. A yield that wide means one of two things: a bargain, or a business the market expects to shrink. Accenture sells its people's time, and the discount is a bet on what AI does to that.

items.title: Is IBM Stock A Buy After Missing On Transaction Processing?
items.summary: International Business Machines (IBM) has given back 12.9% over the past three months and sits at $239.94, about 73% of its 52-week high. Management sees no evidence of clients moving off the mainframe. items.title: Bank FOMO fueling AI spending, Accenture exec says
